direction: Light field atlas: paper ground, dark blue-green ink, teal structure, coral light paths, ochre phase comparison; Source Sans 3 and open annotated drawings.
thesis: An interferometer turns differential changes in two perpendicular optical paths into a measurable interference signal.
model: Two perpendicular 4 km Fabry–Pérot arm cavities
visible_evidence: Connected L-shaped optical layout with input and end mirrors
Outgoing and return light paths have separate lanes
Particle-ring states show opposite changes along orthogonal axes
Wave pairs show cancellation and incomplete cancellation
reading_order: Follow the optical apparatus, compare the deformation states, then read the phase inset and instrument limitations.
production_contract: Editable vector scene generated by scripts/gallery/ligo.js; deterministic optical paths and illustrative waveforms.
scope: Conceptual LIGO optical core. Beam separation and gravitational deformation exaggerated. Recycling optics, squeezing, suspension and readout controls omitted. Waveforms are explanatory, not detector data; no simulated sensitivity claim.
